name: Dragon Chestplate
shortDescription: A red, black, and gold multi-piece dragon chest and back plate based on a Prince Armory pattern, with a future recolor or metal remake planned.
description: The Dragon Chestplate uses a design and pattern by Prince Armory and was originally made and colored following the accompanying tutorial. It is a multi-piece, roughly chevron-shaped chest and back armor set made from leather, with a red base, black trim, and gold lining.

The original coloring was done with an alcohol-based dye, and the color has been fading over time. I plan either to redye the leather in black using oil dye with gold accents, or eventually remake the design in metal.

details.Planned Refinish: Black oil dye with gold accents
